name: Altern

sources.title: Altern homepage - AI index, Buildboard, Leaderboard

requirements: AI-related products/resources only: tools, models, APIs, libraries, agents, datasets, etc.
Sign-in mandatory - GitHub or Google OAuth creates the account automatically ('no separate sign-up needed')
Submission lives in the maker area at /maker/submit/start
preparation: AI product name, URL, description, and a fitting category (Altern has a very large category taxonomy)
Know the listing types visible on the site: AI Agent, AI Model, API, Browser Extension, CLI Tool, Desktop App, Open Source, Python Library
workflow: Open https://altern.ai/maker and click 'Sign in to submit' (or go straight to /maker/submit/start)
Continue with GitHub or Google - this creates the account
Complete the maker submit flow (fields behind auth)
Submitted tools can enter the weekly 'Buildboard' competition and appear under 'Recently added'
watchFor: No public pricing for submissions was found - assumed free, but verify inside the maker flow
Community features (votes, reviews, alternatives suggestions, weekly Buildboard rankings) influence visibility after listing
Help center documents review rules and alternative-suggestion mechanics; read them if also engaging with reviews
countsAsLive: A public AI page exists on altern.ai reachable from /ais or its category, and the tool appears in 'Recently added'.
unknowns: Whether any paid submission/featured tier exists behind auth
Exact submit form fields and review process
Turnaround time and whether listing links are dofollow
